City went beyond state mandate by removing cameras from city streets too
Florida Department of Transportation requirement for state highway cameras specified
Specific resident quotes from Monday's commission meeting included
semantic_publication_gate_merges.reason: Same real-world event: both articles cover Port St. Lucie's decision to remove the same 18 Flock cameras by Sept. 30. The candidate announced the scheduled removal; the incoming article reports the removal actually happened on that date and provides the material update that the commission voted to end the program (not just pause it) and that the city went beyond state requirements by removing cameras from city streets as well. This is a material development in the ongoing story that belongs in the existing canonical rather than creating a standalone follow-up.
